# Configuration for Dusk with flick stick. Controls are basically the same as the controller. Makes more sense
#
# (Any line that starts with # is ignored by JoyShockMapper)
# First, reset to defaults so we don't have to set values we don't care about
RESET_MAPPINGS

# Calibrate. Flick stick relies on good calibration; gyro and stick sens make more sens with it, too
#REAL_WORLD_CALIBRATION = 2.85
REAL_WORLD_CALIBRATION = 2.8649
IN_GAME_SENS = 0.1
# Please set IN_GAME_SENS to your in game mouse speed setting whenever you change it

# Button mappings
LLEFT = S
LRIGHT = F
LUP = E
LDOWN = D

LEFT = SCROLLUP           	# Previous weapon
RIGHT = SCROLLDOWN          # Next weapon
#UP =              			# 
#DOWN =      				# 

GYRO_OFF = DOWN    			# Gyro Off

#ZR = SPACE					# NOT WORKING/Brings menu for some reason
ZL = RMOUSE         		# Zoom/alt fireq

R = LMOUSE             		# Shoot
L =  SPACE       			# jump

N = LSHIFT					# walk
W = T						# Roll weapon
E = LCONTROL       			# crouch
S = R         				# Use

GyroConfigs/Dusk/NEUTRAL.txt

#L3 =         
R3 = G             			# Flashlight            
+ = ESC          			# pause
- = F6          			# Quick Save

#UP,N= 5           # Chorded Press for Syringe. To use chords just hold the First button then tap the second.
#UP,W= 7           # Chorded Press for Shield Cells
#UP,S= 8           # Chorded Press for Shield Battery
#UP,E= 6           # Chorded Press for Medkit
#UP,ZR= 9          # Chorded Press For Phoenix kit

GyroConfigs/_3Dmouse.txt
